description: Find AdButler API endpoints by keyword when no specific tool matches what you need. Returns matching endpoints with their HTTP method, path, and a brief summary. Use this when the user asks about a concept that is a *field* rather than a resource — e.g. 'priority', 'pacing', 'frequency cap', 'metadata', 'tracking pixel' — and you can't find a tool that handles it. Then call describe_adbutler_api on the most promising hit, then call_adbutler_api to invoke it.

query.description: Keyword(s) to search for. Single word works best.

name: search_adbutler_api
